class.name: OcgBndBox2d
class.brief_description: Describes a bounding box in 2D space. A bounding box is parallel to the axes of the coordinates system. If it is finite, it is defined by the two intervals: - [ Xmin,Xmax ], and - [ Ymin,Ymax ]. A bounding box may be infinite (i.e. open) in one or more directions. It is said to be: - OpenXmin if it is infinite on the negative side of the "X Direction"; - OpenXmax if it is infinite on the positive side of the "X Direction"; - OpenYmin if it is infinite on the negative side of the "Y Direction"; - OpenYmax if it is infinite on the positive side of the "Y Direction"; - WholeSpace if it is infinite in all four directions. In this case, any point of the space is inside the box; - Void if it is empty. In this case, there is no point included in the box. A bounding box is defined by four bounds (Xmin, Xmax, Ymin and Ymax) which limit the bounding box if it is finite, six flags (OpenXmin, OpenXmax, OpenYmin, OpenYmax, WholeSpace and Void) which describe the bounding box if it is infinite or empty, and - a gap, which is included on both sides in any direction when consulting the finite bounds of the box.

method.name: Bnd_Box2d
method.description: Creates an empty 2D bounding box. The constructed box is qualified Void. Its gap is null.

method.name: SetWhole
method.description: Sets this bounding box so that it covers the whole 2D space, i.e. it is infinite in all directions.

method.name: SetVoid
method.description: Sets this 2D bounding box so that it is empty. All points are outside a void box.

method.name: Set_1
method.description:
Sets this 2D bounding box so that it bounds the point P. This involves first setting this bounding box to be void and then adding the point PThe rectangle bounds the point

.

method.name: Set_2
method.description: Sets this 2D bounding box so that it bounds the half-line defined by point P and direction D, i.e. all points M defined by M=P+u*D, where u is greater than or equal to 0, are inside the bounding area. This involves first setting this 2D box to be void and then adding the half-line.

method.name: Update_2
method.description: Enlarges this 2D bounding box, if required, so that it contains at least: - interval [ aXmin,aXmax ] in the "X Direction", - interval [ aYmin,aYmax ] in the "Y Direction"

method.name: Update_1
method.description: Adds a point of coordinates (X,Y) to this bounding box.

method.name: GetGap
method.description: Returns the gap of this 2D bounding box.

method.name: SetGap
method.description: Set the gap of this 2D bounding box to abs(Tol).

method.name: Enlarge
method.description: Enlarges the box with a tolerance value. This means that the minimum values of its X and Y intervals of definition, when they are finite, are reduced by the absolute value of Tol, while the maximum values are increased by the same amount.

method.name: Get
method.description: Returns the bounds of this 2D bounding box. The gap is included. If this bounding box is infinite (i.e. "open"), returned values may be equal to +/- Precision::Infinite(). if IsVoid()

method.name: OpenXmin
method.description: The Box will be infinitely long in the Xmin direction.

method.name: OpenXmax
method.description: The Box will be infinitely long in the Xmax direction.

method.name: OpenYmin
method.description: The Box will be infinitely long in the Ymin direction.

method.name: OpenYmax
method.description: The Box will be infinitely long in the Ymax direction.

method.name: IsOpenXmin
method.description: Returns true if this bounding box is open in the Xmin direction.

method.name: IsOpenXmax
method.description: Returns true if this bounding box is open in the Xmax direction.

method.name: IsOpenYmin
method.description: Returns true if this bounding box is open in the Ymin direction.

method.name: IsOpenYmax
method.description: Returns true if this bounding box is open in the Ymax direction.

method.name: IsWhole
method.description: Returns true if this bounding box is infinite in all 4 directions (Whole Space flag).

method.name: IsVoid
method.description: Returns true if this 2D bounding box is empty (Void flag).

method.name: Transformed
method.description: Returns a bounding box which is the result of applying the transformation T to this bounding box. Warning Applying a geometric transformation (for example, a rotation) to a bounding box generally increases its dimensions. This is not optimal for algorithms which use it.

method.name: Add_1
method.description: Adds the 2d box <Other> to <me>.

method.name: Add_2
method.description: Adds the 2d point.

method.name: Add_4
method.description: Extends bounding box from thePnt in the direction theDir.

method.name: Add_3
method.description: Extends the Box in the given Direction, i.e. adds a half-line. The box may become infinite in 1 or 2 directions.

method.name: IsOut_1
method.description:
Returns True if the 2d pnt

is out .

method.name: IsOut_2
method.description: Returns True if the line doesn't intersect the box.

method.name: IsOut_4
method.description: Returns True if the segment doesn't intersect the box.

method.name: IsOut_3
method.description: Returns True if <Box2d> is out <me>.

method.name: IsOut_5
method.description: Returns True if transformed <Box2d> is out <me>.

method.name: IsOut_6
method.description: Compares a transformed bounding with a transformed bounding. The default implementation is to make a copy of <me> and <Other>, to transform them and to test.

method.name: SquareExtent
method.description: Computes the squared diagonal of me.
